Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:

- Design and implement advanced Generative AI models to solve complex problems.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions into existing systems.

- Conduct research and stay updated with the latest advancements in NLP and AI technologies.

- Develop scalable and efficient AI algorithms to enhance product offerings.

- Mentor junior team members and share knowledge to foster a culture of learning.




Good to have skills:

Machine Learning, Data Analysis, Deep Learning, Python Programming, Cloud Computing




Technical and Professional Requirements:

• Primary skills: Machine Learning->Generative AI-> Agentic AI-> Large Language Models-> NLP-> Artificial Intelligence

Technology->AI-Agentic AI->Agent Engineering

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:

- Design and implement advanced Generative AI models to solve complex problems.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions into existing systems.

- Conduct research and stay updated with the latest advancements in NLP and AI technologies.

- Develop scalable and efficient AI algorithms to enhance product offerings.

- Mentor junior team members and share knowledge to foster a culture of learning.




Good to have skills:

Machine Learning, Data Analysis, Deep Learning, Python Programming, Cloud Computing




Technical and Professional Requirements:

• Primary skills: Machine Learning->Generative AI-> Agentic AI-> Large Language Models-> NLP-> Artificial Intelligence


Preferred Skills:

Technology->AI-Generative AI->Prompt Engineering
Technology->AI-Agentic AI->Agent Engineering

Core Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy generative AI applications and systems (eg, intelligent document processing, conversational agents, knowledge retrieval systems)
Work with data scientists and engineers to source, clean, and prepare datasets to build and optimize RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, multi-agent workflows, conversational interfaces) through API integration with LLMs (provided by OpenAI, Anthropic, Google), open-source models (eg Hugging Face/Lllama), and orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex).
Integrate AI solutions into applications-build APIs, front-ends, and other endpoints for model interaction.
Test, evaluate, and validate generative AI outputs for quality, safety, and fairness by using evaluation frameworks for LLM applications (accuracy, hallucination, recall).
Implement prompt optimization strategies for cost and quality.
Design conversation management and memory systems
Build guardrails and safety layers for production LLM applications
Document solutions, experiments, and code to ensure best practices and reproducibility.
Collaborate closely with business and technical teams to align AI solutions with user and project needs.
Mandatory Skills
Lead the design, implementation, and optimization of advanced/end-to-end generative architectures, including RAG, agents, and guardrails.
Design evaluation strategies for complex LLM systems.
Lead implementation of multi-agent orchestration systems.
Design cost optimization strategies across LLM providers.
Evaluate third-party models, frameworks, and open-source tools for adoption.
Guide teams in responsible AI practices (eg, explainability, fairness).
Engage with non-technical stakeholders to clarify complex AI concepts and solution value.
Lead code reviews, establish coding standards, and mentor less experienced team members.

Roles & Responsibility


LLM as mandatory experience in use case implementation

Gen AI / AI Engineer with 8 years of Experience

Key responsibilities
Build and operationalize machine-learning models for document processing.
Design and deploy AI solutions that extract insights from complex legal documents using Generative AI.
Design, develop, and deploy Agentic AI solutions using LLMs, tool calling, and multi-agent workflows.
Build intelligent AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, and executing tasks across enterprise systems and knowledge sources.
Leverage agentic AI and Gen AI tooling day-to-day in testing and framework development.
Collaborate with product owners, architects, data engineers, and business stakeholders to translate business problems into AI-driven solutions.

Must-have qualifications & experience
Python + PySpark for data pipelining and ingestion.
Solid grasp of Data Engineering patterns: landing (raw/source), cleansing (core/foundation), building domain entities; experience with large-scale data pipelines and distributed computing.
LLM-powered applications & AI assistants; hands-on Agentic AI architectures (planning, reasoning, tool use, workflow orchestration).
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solution implementation.
Prompt engineering, plus evaluation frameworks and AI-application testing methodologies.
LLM deployment, governance, security, and responsible-AI practices.
Solid understanding of machine learning, deep learning, and MLOps practices (build operationalize monitor in production).
Familiarity with modern AI/ML frameworks — e.g. PyTorch or TensorFlow — and LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain / LangGraph / Microsoft Agent Framework).
Hands-on use of coding agents and agentic development daily.
Able to work remotely full-time. Customer and project interview required.




 Nice-to-have
Generative AI and/or Natural Language Processing experience.
Vector databases and semantic-search technologies.
Microsoft Azure AI Foundry and/or Microsoft Agent Framework.
Insurance / reinsurance domain knowledge.
Production AI deployment with model monitoring/maintenance
Solution-focused, universal mindset; comfortable with high-complexity tasks.

We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer with strong expertise in Agentic AI, AI Deployment, and AI Implementation to build and deploy enterprise-grade GenAI solutions. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in developing AI agents, implementing RAG solutions, integrating LLMs, and deploying AI applications in production environments.




Location: PAN India (Hybrid)
Experience: 5-10 Years

Notice Period: Immediate to 30 Days




Job Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and deploy Agentic AI and GenAI solutions.
Build AI agents, RAG applications, and enterprise copilots.
Deploy and manage AI solutions in production environments.
Integrate LLMs with enterprise applications and workflows.

Requirements:

5+ years of AI/ML experience.
Hands-on experience with Agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, etc.).
Strong experience in AI deployment and implementation.
Proficiency in Python and cloud platforms (Azure preferred).
Must be available to join within 30 days.

Roles and Responsibilities :

Design, develop, and deploy large language models using Azure AI Search to improve search functionality on e-commerce platforms.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate natural language processing (NLP) capabilities into existing systems.
Develop and maintain complex NLP pipelines using tools like LangChain for data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model training.
Troubleshoot issues related to model performance, scalability, and reliability in a production environment.

Job Requirements :

8-12 years of experience in Artificial Intelligence Engineering with expertise in Large Language Model development.
Strong understanding of Azure AI Search services including its architecture, features, and integrations.
Proficiency in developing custom solutions using Azure Functions or other serverless technologies.
Experience working with open-source libraries such as TensorFlow or PyTorch for building machine learning models.

KEY RESPONSABILITIES

Design and implement GenAI applications using LLMs, embeddings, and prompt orchestration patterns.
Build and optimize retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines and supporting components.
Develop and maintain integrations with vector databases, APIs, and enterprise data sources.
Engineer prompts, evaluation strategies, and guardrails for quality, relevance, and safety.
Collaborate with product, architecture, and security teams to design scalable GenAI solutions.
Monitor GenAI application performance, cost, latency, and output quality.
Implement version control, testing, and deployment workflows for GenAI assets.
Support troubleshooting, iterative tuning, and operational improvement of GenAI applications.
Document solution design, limitations, risks, and technical decisions.

REQUIREMENTS

Strong Python skills and hands-on experience building AI applications.
Practical experience with LLM ecosystems and orchestration frameworks.
Solid understanding of prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, and vector search concepts.
Experience integrating AI services through APIs and enterprise systems.
Familiarity with cloud environments and containerization basics.
Hands-on with Git and basic CI/CD practices.
Awareness of AI risks such as hallucinations, privacy, prompt injection, and governance needs.
Strong communication, experimentation mindset, and pragmatic problem-solving.

NICE-TO-HAVE

Familiarity with vector databases and semantic search solutions.
Exposure to fine-tuning, evaluation frameworks, or agentic workflows.
Knowledge of responsible AI, security controls, and enterprise AI governance.
Experience balancing model quality, latency, and cost in production use cases.

Title: Senior AI Engineer / Lead AI Engineer / AI Technical Lead




Experience: 7 to 8+ years in software/AI engineering, with substantial hands-on AI/ML experience




Location : Navi Mumbai (work From Office)




Core ownership: AI architecture model/LLM selection development production deployment monitoring technical leadership.




Job Summary




We are looking for a hands-on Lead AI Engineer / AI Technical Lead to design, develop, and lead production-grade AI solutions. The role requires strong expertise in AI/ML, Generative AI, LLMs/VLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, and AI system architecture, along with technical leadership experience.




Key Responsibilities



AI/ML: ML, deep learning, NLP, computer vision, OCR/document intelligence, model training/fine-tuning and evaluation.
Generative AI: LLMs, VLMs, embeddings, prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool/function calling.
Agentic AI: RAG, AI agents, multi-agent orchestration, LangChain/LangGraph, MCP, memory, guardrails and human-in-the-loop workflows.
Production AI: Python, FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift, REST APIs, microservices, GPU inference.
LLMOps/MLOps: model versioning, evaluation, observability, latency/cost optimization, CI/CD and production monitoring.
Enterprise architecture: secure deployment, RBAC, API security, data privacy, auditability and on-prem/private-cloud AI.
Leadership: architecture/design reviews, mentoring engineers, POCs, technical decision-making, stakeholder communication, and taking solutions from POC to production.

Qualification & Experience




Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, IT, or related field, with 7 to 8+ years of relevant industry experience and proven experience delivering production-grade AI solutions.




Interested Candidate can CV with sanket.shigwan@aurionpro.com

We are looking for an AI Prompt Engineer who can design, test, and optimize prompts for AI-powered applications to improve accuracy, efficiency, and user experience. The role requires strong analytical thinking, creativity, and hands-on experience with Generative AI tools.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and optimize prompts for AI models (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.).
Create prompt libraries, templates, and reusable workflows for business use cases.
Test, evaluate, and refine prompts to improve response quality and accuracy.
Monitor AI outputs and implement improvements based on performance metrics.
Research emerging AI trends, tools, and prompt engineering techniques.
Ensure AI-generated content aligns with business objectives, compliance, and ethical standards.
Document best practices, prompt guidelines, and usage instructions.



Required Skills

Strong understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Prompt Engineering.
Hands-on experience with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, or similar AI tools.
Excellent written communication and analytical skills.
Ability to create structured prompts for content generation, automation, research, and problem-solving.
Basic understanding of APIs, AI workflows, and automation tools is preferred.
Knowledge of Python, SQL, or no-code automation platforms (Zapier, Make, etc.) is an added advantage.

We are seeking a passionate and innovative AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy AI-driven solutions for our platform. As an AI Engineer, you will work on building intelligent systems that enhance user engagement, provide personalized learning experiences, and drive our mission to democratize coding education.


AI Model Development
Design, train, and optimize machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) models for use cases such as: Real-time (Coding co-pilot) code suggestions and debugging.
Conversational AI for mentorship and learning guidance.
Code generation and review tools.


Algorithm Design and Optimization
Develop algorithms for recommendation systems to personalize user experiences.
Build efficient NLP and NLU pipelines for understanding coding queries.
Implement solutions for automated error detection and resolution in code.


Integration and Deployment
Collaborate with software engineers to integrate AI models into the Edureify platform.
Deploy models in a scalable and reliable manner using tools like Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
Monitor model performance post-deployment and implement updates for continuous improvement.


Data Pipeline Management
Design and maintain data pipelines to collect, preprocess, and annotate data.
Work with big data frameworks (e.g., Hadoop, Spark) to handle large-scale datasets.


Collaboration and Innovation
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, engineering, design) to align AI functionalities with user needs.
Stay updated on the latest AI trends, tools, and frameworks, and evaluate their potential for integration.


Required:
Education: Bachelor s/Master s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, or related fields.
Experience: 3-5 years in AI/ML development, with a proven track record of deploying AI models in production.
Programming: Proficiency in Python and frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit-learn.
NLP Expertise: Experience in natural language processing (NLP) and working with LLMs.
Data Engineering: Strong understanding of data preprocessing, feature engineering, and working with structured and unstructured data.
Cloud Proficiency: Hands-on experience with cloud-based AI/ML services (AWS SageMaker, Google AI, Azure ML).


Preferred:
Knowledge of DevOps practices for AI model deployment.
Familiarity with MLOps frameworks and tools (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow).
Expertise in Reinforcement Learning (RL) and its application in interactive systems.
